player_prompt.intro:
Sikayo so nanlapuan ed Tower of Hanoi kaiba {num_disks} a disk.
Say katwan yo so ilakad so disk manlapud tower A ed tower C.
No ontan mo ilakad so disk, sulat mo so source tower tan target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Awanan, say impitapewa yo mo so top disk diad tower, tan say mas large a disk aliwan ag a mas small a disk.
Diad anggad turn, isubmit mo so masan.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sa kaiba, agmo so valid a '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Inusar mo so aliwan valid a source odino target tower.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Sinali yon iyalis so sakey a disk manlapud anggapoy gamit ya tori.
invalid_move.same_tower: Sinali yon iyalis so sakey a disk diad parehon tori.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Sinali yon iyalis so baleg a disk ed melag ya disk.

game_action.moved: Inilakad mo so disk {disk} manlapud {source} ed {target}.

outcome.win: Komendasyon! Asolusyonan yo so misteryo na Tower of Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Akasabi la so limitasyon na panag-turn. {pct}% ed saray disk et susto ya inyan mo diad Tower C.
